compatible.note: SessionSummary.branches (master, chat worktree rows): optional and additive; an older page ignores it, and a page reading a host without it shows the row as before

SessionSummary.fixedName, optional about on Overseer history rows, optional overseer on monitor rows and history groups: all additive. An older page ignores them; it still draws, but its Overseer History rows read the fixed name in title, and its Rename gets the refusal sentence
SessionSummary.jobsRunning, optional and additive: the count of a shut-down chat's running background jobs. An older page ignores it and shows no job running marker
Branch place (§chat.worktrees/place): optional additive place on SessionBranchRow; an older page ignores it and shows the bare branch.

WorktreeReadiness and SessionBranchRow gain optional left and draftsLeft, the shared answer on a branch (§chat.worktrees/nothing-left): additive. An older page ignores them and reads the state and reason it always did. A page reading a host without them shows each row by its readiness, as before

the merge of the optional place on SessionBranchRow with optional left and draftsLeft on WorktreeReadiness and SessionBranchRow: both additive lines above together, nothing new beyond them, so each older reader copes as its own entry says

master: optional mcp {server, tool} on tool calls and their events, optional mcpNote on a transcript row, optional WakeInfo.extJob; all additive: an older page draws the same rows and leaves the MCP name and note out

ProjectMinorInfo.personal and .replaces (a mode from your own folder, and one that took over the project's mode of its id): optional and additive, still one row per id. An older page ignores them: the same rows, states and approval, with no Your modes group or takeover note, and its approval says the mode comes from the project's files. A page reading a host without them shows every mode as the project's
optional WakeInfo.job and WakeInfo.endedAt on a background job's end card: additive. An older page ignores both and draws the row from its other fields

sova_pair joins the acts an Overseer permit can name (GrantableAct, §app.overseer/pairs); additive: an older page still draws the permit row and its other acts, leaving the new act's word blank in the list

the merge of both additive lines: ProjectMinorInfo.personal and .replaces, with optional WakeInfo.job and WakeInfo.endedAt and sova_pair in GrantableAct. Nothing new beyond them, so each older reader copes as its own entry above says

shell mode: the shell row kind (a command run with ! or !!, TranscriptItem.shell), the hello's optional shell runs and shellMode, and the shell_* messages, all on wire 2, on top of the lines above; additive: an older page draws a shell row as an Unrecognized entry with the raw entry (its command and output) under Raw entry, ignores the hello's new fields and the messages, and offers no shell mode; a wire-1 reader still gets the plain $ command row

a chat socket's cards_changed frame, no content, sent only when one of that chat's transcript cards changes, and optional CardRaiser.id on an extension's raiser. Additive: an older page's frame switch has no case for the type and passes over it, showing the change at its next poll; it reads the raiser's title as before
the merge of shell mode with master's cards_changed frame and CardRaiser.id: both additive lines above together, nothing new beyond them, so each older reader copes as its own entry says

shell mode's cleanup on this branch, every addition together: a draft's optional ShellDraftMode beside its text; ShellOutputPage for the whole-output route; ShellCancelReason gains limit (stopped at the output limit) and other (stopped by the Stop Command entry); ShellOutcome.durationMs; ShellRefusal loses running (several commands run at once, so a host never sends it). An older page reads a limit- or other-stopped row as stopped by you, draws no took time, ignores the draft's mode and never calls the new route; a newer page shows an older host's running refusal by its message, as any refusal

al_3 merge queue automation on the merge queue card (sova.merge-queue): optional MergeCard.standing, tries, decision and fixesLanded, optional entry requests/tries/standing/fix/decision/ruling, new entry states with-chat and needs-user, a decision revision kind, ConflictJudgement verdict chat-fixes. Additive: an older page draws the card from its other fields; an entry in a state it doesn't know shows no state word, and its Send Back (retired) is refused by the server with the reason

al_3: optional MergeRequestInfo.hostSentBack (the host problem last sent back to the branch's chat) and an optional decision id on a page's prompt/steer frame (the merge queue decision its held note answers). Additive: an older page never reads hostSentBack, and an older server ignores the frame's decision and attaches the newest waiting note

the merge of master's shell mode (and its cleanup) with al_3's merge queue automation lines above: both sets of additive lines together, nothing new beyond them, so each older reader copes as its own entry says
TeamMessageInfo.orchestrator dropped (optional, set only from old team-question headers; no reader used it). An older reader sees it absent, as it already did for every current header

Profiles (§chat.profiles/switch): a chat socket's chat_profile message (the profile the chat is on, (edited), a switch waiting for the reply) and an optional model on a turn failure's error beside its provider. Additive: an older page's frame switch has no case for chat_profile and passes over it (its menu shows the helpers pick as before), and it ignores error.model
Branch place (§chat.worktrees/place): an optional place on a merge queue batch note's request; an older page ignores it and shows the bare branch.
Design mode: two SovaEvents on a chat socket, design.live and design.state. Additive: an older page's live reducer has no case for the type and passes over it; it never shows a design card anyway

shell mode: the shell and shell_stop frames a page sends, wire 2 only; additive: a page offers shell mode only on a hello carrying shellMode, which an older host never sends, and a Run before the hello sends nothing, so an older host never gets one; its other frames are unchanged

shell mode's cleanup: a draft's optional mode beside its text (ShellDraftMode) and shell_stop naming one of several running commands; additive: an older host ignores the draft's mode and saves it as a message, and stops the one command it runs by its id as before

al_3 merge queue automation: optional standing, decision and tries on a worktree row's queue entry (WorktreeQueueInfo, BranchQueueFacts), new entry states with-chat and needs-user. Additive: an older page draws the row from its other fields and shows no state word for a state it doesn't know

the merge of master's shell mode frames (and their cleanup) with al_3's optional queue fields on a worktree row: both additive lines above together, nothing new beyond them, so each older reader copes as its own entry says
POST /api/sessions takes an optional byOverseer; additive: an older reader ignores it and starts the session as it did before.
A published extension may leave out dist or api (v1.20, no page or no program). An older peer's validate drops such an entry, so it isn't listed there; every other entry and field reads as before.
